reviews.reviewText: MTH101 ka paper zyada tar files aur handouts se tha. MCQs chote chote thay jin mein derivatives, integration aur limits se related questions aaye. Integrate kar ke limits lagani thi, kuch questions substitution se thay. Convergence aur divergence se related short aur long questions bhi shamil thay. Overall paper easy aur conceptual tha.
MCQs files se thay. Integration, Taylor series, ratio test, substitution aur convergence divergence se questions aaye. Cylindrical shell method aur geometric series bhi important thay.

Paper easy tha. Sigma series, convergent aur divergent tests bohat important thay. Increasing decreasing tests aur integration ke tamam formulas yaad hona zaroori thay, khas tor par volume wale formulas. Last 10 lectures sab se zyada important thay aur MCQs ka bara hissa wahin se aaya.

Lectures 30-45 sab se zyada important hain. MCQs zyada tar lectures 19-30 se aate hain jab ke short aur long questions 30-45 se aate hain. Handouts ko achi tarah revise karein, Kinza Bilal ke lectures helpful hain aur zyada se zyada practice karein.
